title: Grandma's House
description: We learn about Mount St. Helens which was a volcano that erupted several ago, we also learn that a man lived at the base of the mountain named Harry Truman. Harry refused to listen to the warnings and information that was given to him in regards to a soon coming eruption of the long dormant volcano. Sadly he lost his life, what can we learn from this experience?
